audit.why: Difficulty 7/10 with a 50.99% win rate over 2622 games is a fair read: Aurora out-ranges Chain Lash (775) with her 900-range Q and holds an exit on Across the Veil (22s at rank 1), but Sylas answers her ultimate with Hijack. Early is Aurora's, mid is even, side lane and teamfights hinge on whether Between Worlds gets copied.

Spikes recorded: level 2 (Across the Veil online = trade exit), level 3 (full kit trade loop), level 6 (Between Worlds vs Hijack, 80s at rank 1), first item (Luden's rotation), 2+ items. Sylas's own spike is a completed first item plus Kingslayer rank-ups (12s at rank 1 down to 6s at rank 5), not level 6 by itself.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] claims Sylas's ultimate steal 'only matters if he lands Q/E and survives to cast it'. Hijack is a 950-range steal on an enemy champion; it does not require Chain Lash or Abscond to connect first.
audit.why: Riot's text for Hijack: 'Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely.' No landed ability is a precondition. The rest of the interaction set is right: Chain Lash slows then detonates after a delay, Kingslayer is his only heal and is Grievous-Wounds bait, Abscond dashes and recasts as Abduct to pull him to a hit target (13s at rank 1).
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 change nothing for him: Chain Lash is still 10s at rank 1 and Kingslayer only heals when it connects.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.trading was the tradeGood and tradeBad strings concatenated verbatim, adding nothing beyond those two fields.
audit.why: Grounded the good trade in Chain Lash's delayed second explosion and the bad trade in Kingslayer's 12s rank-1 heal plus the anti-heal requirement flagged in missingInteractions.
breakdown.cooldowns already carries real numbers: Abscond/Abduct 13/12/11/10/9s, Chain Lash 10s at rank 1 down to 6s at rank 5, Across the Veil 22s at rank 1. All match the kit files.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave's worst-wave clause was Aurora-generic — it described a hop-less Aurora without naming anything Sylas does to punish a frozen wave.
audit.why: Chain Lash zones the melee minions from 775 range and Abscond into Abduct closes the remaining gap, which is the actual reason a freeze at his tower is lethal here.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d said Sylas 'burns Abscond on a wave' — Abscond is a dash, not wave clear, so the stated trigger is wrong even though the 13s window is right.
audit.why: Sylas spends Abscond to roam or to engage, not to clear; the correct read is that a roamed-away Abscond is the window to crash and follow.

report[8] already names Grievous Wounds against his sustain, which covers the missingInteractions anti-heal rule for Kingslayer. Reinforced it in breakdown.trading so the buy timing appears where the extended trade is described.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim under the title 'Fight near your R zone's exit edge', and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim under 'Greed the recast at half HP'. dontsFull[0].d was a content-free template line.
audit.why: Both lint findings confirmed; bodies rewritten to match their titles using Between Worlds' teleport, the Q recast's return travel, and Abduct's pull.

Packet defect said the page never names any Sylas ability; it now names Chain Lash, Kingslayer, Abscond/Abduct, Petricite Burst and Hijack throughout, and this proposal adds Chain Lash's delayed detonation as the reason to exit early.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E the step-up, Q-recast the slowed target, hop out — a full pattern he answered with a whiff.
edits.after: Between Worlds teleports you across the zone — fight on its edge so Abduct's pull drops you beside your exit.

edits.before: Sylas burns Abscond on a wave — that is a 13-second window to shove and roam.
edits.after: Once Abscond is spent on a roam, that 13s is your window to crash and follow.

edits.before: That is Sylas’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: W spent for spacing is W absent when Abduct pulls — his 13s dash catches you flat.

edits.before: Hopping IN with W and trading while his engage is still loaded — the exit spent as an entrance is how Auroras get coached postmortem.
edits.after: The Q recast drags the curse back through him — at half HP that extra second in range is all Abduct plus Kingslayer needs.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the last-hit, E the step-up, Q-recast the slowed target, hop out — a full pattern he answered with a whiff. Bad trade: Hopping IN with W and trading while his engage is still loaded — the exit spent as an entrance is how Auroras get coached postmortem.
edits.after: Good trade: Q the last-hit, E his step-up, Q-recast the slowed target, hop out before Chain Lash's delayed blast lands. Bad trade: extended range with Kingslayer up — his 12s heal at rank 1 refunds your chip unless Grievous Wounds is already bought.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-recast cleared push that crashes on your trade timers — your patterns farm and poke in the same cast. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with W down — hop-less Aurora is a skinny mage with a haste passive and regrets. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.
edits.after: Best wave: a Q-recast cleared push that crashes on your trade timers — your patterns farm and poke in the same cast. Worst wave: frozen near his tower with W down — Chain Lash zones you off the melee minions and Abduct closes the rest. Crash timing: shove with a destination in mind; mid waves are bus tickets, not chores.

edits.before: Carry through tempo — patterns that exit free compound; your zone turns objective fights into speed checks they fail.
edits.after: Carry by pacing Hijack: he gets one steal per 80s at rank 1, so take the fight right after he spends it, zone speed included.

edits.before: His ultimate steal only matters if he lands Q/E and survives to cast it, and pre-6 he has no way to force that.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 change nothing for him: Chain Lash is still 10s at rank 1 and Kingslayer only heals when it connects.

notes: Level chart untouched: all seven rows read Aurora with 5/10-6/10 ratings, which matches a 50.99% win rate over 2622 games and the packet levelChart (also all Aurora), so nothing was flipped. breakdown.difficulty ('Tricky matchup — difficulty 7/10, Sylas carry threat 7.5/10.') is structurally templated across the champion but is a pure ratings restatement with no room inside the length band to ground it in Sylas's kit — left alone rather than padded. Spell-shield/QSS/tenacity behaviour for Abduct's pull and Between Worlds' shockwave is not in Riot's text and was not asserted.
